_comment: Storyboard map for meta-create-skill VIDEO 5: The Retrospective (CP2's self-improvement explainer). 5 diagrams in teaching order, one column each, left to right. Arc: Pain (the correction dies in the chat) -> Mechanism (it gets written into the file) -> Trust (nothing lands without your yes) -> How to run it (one command, two modes) -> Payoff (it compounds). The deck lives in CP2 because the loop only pays off if the buyer learns it on their FIRST run, not at the finish line.
